articles.title: 32% ‘FULLY TRUST' THEIR AI AGENTS. 4 IN 10 OF THEM STILL APPROVE EVERY ACTION
articles.summary: Nylas surveyed 1,030 AI builders and buyers. 32% said they fully trust an agent to run on its own, yet 4 in 10 of them require human approval on every action. Trust depends on the task: teams will let an agent schedule a meeting (56%) long before they'll let it email a customer (44%) or change a system setting (27%).
